objective: Can the F06 ICA Qwen3.6-27B source provide verifiably identified fitted numerical direction files without executing Qwen, and does that alone meet requirements for recipient-native transplantation?
prohibited_operations: download model or SAE matrix bytes
write donor labels or activation examples

eligibility_rules.metadata_read_pass: JSON object contains the exact requested id and 40-hex revision, bounded list of filenames; license presence recorded without assuming it conveys rights to third-party explanations
eligibility_rules.listed_matrix_candidate: At least one .safetensors/.pt/.pth file with a path explicitly indicating target layer 32; listing only, no byte or coordinate verification
eligibility_rules.numerical_transplant_pass: REQUIRES real pinned and hashed matrix bytes, source-model SHA mapping, independent causal feature semantics, paired native recipient observation/state interface, matched controls; NOT satisfied by this metadata-only operation
eligibility_rules.no_go: If any numerical-transplant predicate remains absent, classify NO_GO_NUMERICAL_TRANSPLANT_WITH_NO_INFERENCE_METADATA; preserve existing result and do not promote source
eligibility_rules.source_error: Missing/bad/oversized/inconsistent source is SOURCE_CUSTODY_BLOCKED, not evidence donor concepts fail

controls: metadata with matrix filename but no actual matrix bytes
artifact_reuse_rights: Model, ICA fitted artifact, dashboard-derived text and any output-source rights evaluated separately
post_result_rule: No threshold edits or feature changes based on outcome; stop or separately preregister a different research mechanism
initial_baseline: QTR-01 F06 exact source identity confirmed; zero explanations for feature 77; no donor inference or recipient alignment
